# LabVIEW — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created LabVIEW?", "National Instruments"),
    ("What paradigm is LabVIEW?", "graphical dataflow"),
    ("What is creator?", "National Instruments"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1986"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "graphical dataflow"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".vi"),
    ("What is hello world?", "(wired \"Hello, world!\" indicator)"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
